title: XAUUSD Selective Strategy A - independent pre-registered shadow forward test (simulation only, no orders)
status: registered - NOT launched. A third runner starts only after operator approval of the launch-readiness checklist.
label: INDEPENDENT PROSPECTIVE SHADOW VALIDATION - only bars closing at or after unseen_window_starts count as evidence
data: XAUUSD M5 closed bars + live ticks from MetaQuotes-Demo via the read-only MT5 allowlist connector, server tz eet_eu; 15M/1H/4H built causally from M5 (UTC-aligned buckets, forming bucket dropped)
unseen_window_rule: If the runner is not launched and warmed up before 2026-11-13T21:00:00Z, the start date may be moved ONCE, by a committed amendment made before the new date, to a later Monday 00:00 UTC. Nothing else may change. Data before the start is never evidence.

previously_examined_data_excluded.exploratory: 2025-12-30 -> 2026-11-06 (frozen parameters, 277 trades, +0.109 R, CI -0.070..+0.290; examined in Phase 2A for other strategies)
previously_examined_data_excluded.rule: No result from 2025-06 -> 2026-11-08 is used as validation evidence; those periods are cited only as the reason for this test.

candidates.frozen_from: docs/mtf-hybrid-research.md section 5: RR 2.5, pull_atr 0.25, confirm_bars 6; all other parameters at the SelectiveParams defaults used in the research
candidates.adapter_parity: On examined 2025-08..2025-09 M5 data the windowed adapter reproduced the research candidates exactly (181/181; mechanics check only, not evidence)

controls.calibration: Strategy A candidates per M5 bar (0.01742) and median stop distance in ATR(14) of M5 (3.42) on the DEVELOPMENT period 2025-06-02 -> 2025-12-30 only. Long share fixed at 0.5 (direction-neutral) instead of the development long share 0.759.
controls.role: random-entry control with the candidate's exits, holding limit and net-RR cost check

secondary_analysis: At each checkpoint, 20 matched random seeds (same trade count, long share, stop distance in ATR units, RR and time limit as the candidate's realised trades) are re-simulated on the recorded live M5 bars with the research simulator. Reported, not a pass criterion.

rules.entry_cost_rule: planned reward-to-risk after spread (fill tick), slippage 0.10/side and commission must be >= min_net_rr 2.0 at the simulated fill; otherwise rejected (as in the research)
rules.costs: spread from live ticks at the simulated fill; slippage 0.10 USD/side; commission scenarios 0 and 7 USD/lot round trip; swap from symbol_info
rules.fills: first tick at or after the signal bar close; stop before take-profit; time exit after 144 M5 bars (12 h)
rules.books: 10,000 and 3,000 USD x commission 0 and 7; one position per book; every entry approved and sized only by trading.risk.evaluate
rules.independence: Own state directory, store, daily-loss ledger, breaker and KILL/STOP files; the Phase 2D ORB and Phase 2E Donchian runners, their parameters, pre-registrations and accounts are not touched
rules.ai_inputs: Kronos forecasts and Grok agent recommendations, if any, are recorded separately as advisory data and never change signals, sizing or approvals

checkpoints: after 50 trades (interim report only; no stopping for success)
final: after >= 150 trades AND >= 183 days from the unseen start, whichever is later; hard end 548 days
success_criteria_all_required: net mean R per trade > 0 under the 7 USD/lot commission scenario
bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of net mean R > 0
candidate net mean R above the net mean R of every one of the 5 random-entry control books
positive net result in at least 2 of the last 3 complete two-month blocks
max drawdown < 8% of equity at 0.5% risk

outcomes.pass: all criteria pass at the final checkpoint -> eligible for operator review; no automatic promotion and no change of execution mode
outcomes.inconclusive_positive: mean R > 0 and every criterion except the CI passes -> ONE pre-declared extension to 300 trades with no changes
outcomes.retire: any other result at the final checkpoint, or the safety stop

evaluation.safety_stop: drawdown >= 10% of the primary book retires the candidate immediately
notes: Criteria evaluated on the 10,000 USD candidate book under the 7 USD/lot round-trip commission scenario.
Two-month blocks are anchored at the unseen start; the most recent three complete blocks are used.
The 3,000 USD books are reported for minimum-lot eligibility (about half of Strategy A's signals were below the 0.01-lot minimum at 3,000 USD in research).

forbidden: changing any parameter, window, cost assumption or criterion after registration
promotion to demo or live execution from this test without a separate approval
AI outputs changing signals, sizing, stops or risk limits
